Hi Maya —

Thanks for the heads up and for attaching the onboarding packet. We're looking into it. Initial read: those ORPHAN-* PO tokens are indeed provisional identifiers the onboarding job assigns when the onboarding record lacks a direct mapping to our internal ledger key; they should be reconciled automatically but occasionally fail when an incoming tax ID or vendor legal name duplicates an existing record.

Ben and Jordan, can you pull the ingestion logs for Acme (tax_id on the form and vendor name) and the ledger mapping for ACME-5001? If it's a duplicate tax_id, we may need to consolidate vendor records and issue a manual ledger patch. Temporary ask for this thread: please confirm whether we can issue a provisional PO that matches Acme's invoice expectation (single PO grouping per invoice) and set a spend cap on the provisional mapping until ledger patch completes.

Maya — we should have an initial remediation plan within 4 business hours; I will follow up with a provisional PO if ops can do that. If you need to hold invoices, please flag which invoice IDs and amounts.

—Vanessa Ortiz

Vanessa / Jordan —

I pulled the onboarding ingestion logs and attached a ledger extract for the past 48 hours that includes Acme's records. Findings:
- There are two onboarding records with tax_id 12-3456789; one mapped to ACME-5001, the other created as a new vendor record (internal id VEN-7834) because the legal name field had a trailing whitespace and our fuzzy match threshold failed.
- The ingestion pipeline created ORPHAN-0001 and ORPHAN-0002 for the records that did not map cleanly; ORPHAN-0001 holds two SKUs that should be on the same PO.
- Spend cap for the orphaned records defaulted to the vendor's previous temporary cap LEG-0042.

Action items I recommend:
1) Merge VEN-7834 into the canonical Acme vendor (ACME-5001) — I can run the database merge but we should schedule the ledger patch during a low-traffic window.
2) Reassign ORPHAN-0001 -> 2026-PO-ACME-0007 (provisional numbering) and move the two SKUs into the single PO record.
3) Update spend cap to match ACME-5001's requested cap (USD 120,000) and flag for procurement review.

I've attached po_ledger_extract.csv with the offending rows and a short SQL snippet at the bottom showing the merge steps. Will coordinate with Jordan on remediation timing.

Attachment: po_ledger_extract.csv
